header.subtitle: why the page shell shows before the data

source.label: THE SERVER
source.sub: renders the page top to bottom

buffer.label: THE HTML STRING
buffer.sub: holds the page until it's done

payloads: the header and menu were ready in a few milliseconds but the server kept the whole page back until the slow reviews query finally came back from the busy database
streaming sends the shell and menu the moment they render and a placeholder holds the spot where the reviews will slot in later once their slow query is finally done

captions.text: why is this page blank for three seconds?
the server waited on one slow query.
streaming sends the page in chunks.
you read the page while the slow part loads.

credits.tail: = flush html as each part is ready
